cohort: Pregnant women who delivered a singleton live birth from 2003 to 2013 in Ottawa, Ontario, Canada
finding: Women with surgically diagnosed endometriosis were found to have an independently elevated risk of placenta previa in pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with endometriosis were found to have an elevated risk of cesarean delivery (RR, 1.24; 95% CI, 1.10-1.40).
